V0222_01_00_00_0.text:
I'm Kalin!
Leader of The Enforcers!
This is gonna be fun!

V0222_01_00_01_0.text:
I'll take you on!
I crave the competition!

V0222_01_00_02_0.text: Time for The Enforcers to do some enforcing!

V0222_01_00_03_0.text: I'll make the streets safe so we can call this place home!

V0222_01_00_04_0.text: There's no bigger Duel gang than Sector Security!

V0222_01_00_05_0.text: By defeating Sector Security, our home will truly be ours!

V0222_01_00_06_0.text: My toughest opponents are within The Enforcers!

V0222_03_00_03_0.text: Your tricks won't work on me!

V0222_03_00_04_0.text: Where's the fun if there's no challenge!

V0222_03_00_05_0.text: I can't clean up Satellite until I defeat you!

V0222_05_00_00_0.text:
This isn't over!
I'm the one who'll stand tall in the end!

V0222_07_09_00_0.text: This is the card I Set!

V0222_07_09_01_0.text: I flip over my Set card!

V0222_11_01_00_0.text: I Summon a monster in Defense Position!

V0222_21_00_00_0.text: The Enforcers are gonna win this Duel!

V0222_21_00_01_0.text: You're not giving up yet, are ya!

V0222_21_00_04_0.text:
This can't be happening...
Not like this...

V0222_21_00_05_0.text: If I surrender, then it's all been for nothing!

V0222_28_00_00_0.text:
The streets are safe!
Thanks to The Enforcers!

V0222_28_00_01_0.text:
My job's not done!
Anyone with a Duel Disk's still a threat!

V0222_28_00_02_0.text:
Heh...
Now that was a Duel worth Duelin'!

V0222_28_00_03_0.text: Don't enter my world if you're not ready to fight!

V0222_28_00_04_0.text: The Enforcers are the best squad in the world!

V0222_29_00_00_0.text:
I have to keep fighting...
Even if I'm the last one left...

V0222_29_00_01_0.text: If I don't defeat you, what's all this been for...

V0222_29_00_02_0.text:
How did it come to this...
Where are my friends...

V0222_29_00_04_0.text: You sold me out, you traitor!

V0222_29_00_05_0.text:
Not bad!
But we still can do bigger and better things!

V0222_33_00_01_0.text: We're the ones who rule these streets!

V0222_33_00_02_0.text: There's nothing that power can't solve!

V0222_30_00_00_0.text: Let's transform Satellite into a home we can be proud of!

V0222_30_00_01_0.text: I have big plans for Satellite!

V0222_30_00_02_0.text: Your silly strategies won't stop my power!

V0222_34_00_00_0.text: You think I could ever leave you behind?

V0222_34_00_02_0.text: There's no team like The Enforcers!

V0222_34_00_03_0.text: I'll squash every bug in Team Insect!

V0222_34_00_04_0.text: Everyone who wears a Duel Disk is my enemy!

V0222_34_00_05_0.text: The world of Dueling isn't for the weakhearted.

V0222_34_00_06_0.text: To truly save Satellite, there's one last foe I gotta fight!

V0222_34_00_07_0.text:
I activate my Trap!
This is gonna be a great Duel!

V0222_34_00_08_0.text: One last ride for The Enforcers!

V0222_34_00_09_0.text: I thought you were going to fight by my side!

V0222_34_00_10_0.text: You can't be satisfied with that!

V0222_34_00_11_0.text:
You sold me out!
You traitor!

V0222_34_00_12_0.text:
I want my revenge...
And they know they deserve it!

V0222_32_00_00_0.text: If we're never gettin' outta Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links, we need to make Duel Links the place to be!

V0222_32_00_01_0.text:
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links!
There's nothing like it!

V0222_35_00_00_0.text:
I'm Kalin Kessler.
Leader of The Enforcers!

V0222_36_00_02_0.text: There's no way I'm leaving you behind!

V0222_36_00_03_0.text: The Enforcers are winning this Duel!
